name: pickle-scoring
description: Pickleball court management and scoring system (LAN-only, offline-first)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pickle/server" "npm run dev -w @pickle/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pickle/web && npm run build -w @pickle/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pickle/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pickle/server && npm run typecheck -w @pickle/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @pickle/web && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
